purpose: Official sources recovered in this work and actionable remaining disclosure gaps. Imported entries point to accepted manifests; a source-found status does not mean an imported or complete employer-year.

statusDefinitions.source-found-awaiting-extraction: Official PDF downloaded or directly linked by official index; employee rows not yet accepted into build.
statusDefinitions.official-source-indexed-awaiting-validat: Official URL discovered in indexed content; full file/scope/period approval still to verify.
statusDefinitions.employee-schedule-not-yet-located: Specific employee disclosure not located in checked sources; does not assert unavailability.
statusDefinitions.scope-review-required: Known mixed or partial cohort requiring explicit scope treatment.
statusDefinitions.official-archive-found-awaiting-document: Primary archive verified, specific salary documents need selection.
statusDefinitions.official-archive-found-awaiting-extracti: Primary archive and sample schedule URLs verified; historical extraction remains.
statusDefinitions.imported: Accepted normalized employee records are included in the build; the linked manifest records validation, scope and any preserved source discrepancies.
statusDefinitions.requires-ocr: Official source located; scanned employee rows require OCR, complete row review and subtotal validation before acceptance.
statusDefinitions.held-for-review: A source is located but its employee records have failed or await a required validation check; no accepted rows are inferred.
